description: Grades candidate names on measurable properties of the string: length, syllables, pronounceability (the radio test), presence in a published English word list, edit distance to major brands, hyphens and digits, and TLD perception. For when the user is choosing between names or asks whether one is any good. It does not check availability. Every component returns its score, weight and basis so the number can be audited; severe properties cap the total instead of being averaged away. Not a search-ranking prediction, and brand_collision is string similarity, not legal clearance. Each of the top 5 results carries a trademark field: close live US and EU registrations and applications, with office, classes, owner and a required caveat. It is a signal, never a clearance, and measured: false means nothing was searched. Components that cannot be measured are returned as unavailable with reasons, never estimated. Read-only. Cannot spend money.
